name: indahl-rubicon
description: Decide what done means before the work, freeze it, then judge the finished work with three blind seats. A two-to-one split stays UNRESOLVED with the minority's reason, every seat voting MET must report its check catching a planted wrong answer, and each seat tries to build a way the work passes every check and still fails. Returns MET, MISSED, UNRESOLVED or CANNOT_TELL. A Stop hook interrupts the first attempt to finish while a row is open: a record and a prompt, not a lock. Nothing is sent outside your session.
